findings.original: We have evolved with the capacity to be dishonest. It's part of our evolutionary psychological make up – because if we gain an advantage over the people around us, we have a greater chance of surviving.
findings.rewritten: Dishonest people get more than others. So they live longer.
findings.why: A1 将原文条件性、概率性的“如果获得优势，存活几率更大”改写成了确定性的“不诚实的人会得更多，因此活得更长”，主体从 if we 变成 all dishonest people，确定性从推测/可能变成断言，且 “chance of surviving” 不等于 live longer。
